# Hive for Google Antigravity

Connect [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) to [Hive](https://hive.com/) to plan, track, and move work forward across projects, actions, intake forms, automations, App Studio dashboards, goals, creative proofing and approvals, resourcing, timesheets, CRM, and finance.

> **New to Hive?** Create a free workspace in under a minute at [hive.com](https://hive.com), authenticate with OAuth in Antigravity, and run `/hive-workspace-design` to bootstrap your projects, intake forms, and dashboards automatically.

## What this plugin includes

- **Remote Hive MCP Server (`hive-mcp`)**: Connects directly to Hive's stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://hive-mind.hive.com/mcp` using OAuth 2.0 (`mcp:read` and `mcp:write` scopes — zero static API keys required) with eager-loaded core tools for workspace, project, action, message, note, goal, and dashboard discovery.
- **Always-On Live Data Safety Rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Enforces read-before-write hygiene, canonical Hive action links (`https://app.hive.com/workspace/<workspaceId>?actionId=<actionId>`), confirmation gates for destructive/bulk/Finance mutations, and readback verification.
- **13 Curated Workflow Skills**:

| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `hive-setup` | Connect and troubleshoot `hive-mcp` OAuth authentication in Antigravity App, IDE, or CLI |
| `project-status` | Build concise, evidence-backed project status and health reports |
| `weekly-plan` | Prioritize assigned active Hive actions into a realistic weekly schedule |
| `meeting-follow-up` | Turn meeting notes, transcripts, or conversations into reviewed Hive actions and drafts |
| `hive-standup` | Summarize completed and updated Hive actions from the last 24 hours |
| `hive-workflows` | Manage actions, subactions, statuses, labels, custom fields, comments, and 3-step File Library uploads |
| `hive-workspace-design` | Bootstrap Hive workspaces, design intake forms, and build recurring App Workflows |
| `hive-reporting` | Summarize App Studio dashboards, widgets, goals, notes, and workspace knowledge |
| `hive-approvals-proofing` | Manage multi-stage approval rounds, proofing versions, and sign-off bottlenecks |
| `hive-revenue-services-ops` | Build CRM handoffs, services delivery, resourcing, timesheet, billing-prep, and Finance workflows |
| `hive-related-work` | Cross-reference a Hive action against related Hive cards and local git commit history |
| `hive-pr` | Create a GitHub PR and link the git branch to its corresponding Hive action |
| `hive-api` | Build external Hive REST, GraphQL, webhook, and MCP integrations and scripts |

## Installation

### Antigravity Marketplace (App, IDE, or CLI)

- **App / IDE**: Open **Customizations > Marketplace**, search for **Hive**, and click **Add**.
- **CLI**:
  ```bash
  agy plugin install hive
  ```

### Direct from GitHub

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/hiveteams/hive-antigravity-plugin
```

### From a local directory

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hiveteams/hive-antigravity-plugin.git
agy plugin install ./hive-antigravity-plugin
```

## Connect your Hive account (OAuth 2.0)

`hive-mcp` authenticates via browser-based OAuth 2.0 against `https://hive-mind.hive.com/mcp` (`https://hive-mind.hive.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`) — no manual API keys required:

1. **Antigravity App / IDE**: Open Agent settings (`⌘,` on macOS or `Ctrl+,` on Windows/Linux), go to **Customizations > Installed > MCP Servers**, click **Authenticate** next to `hive-mcp`, and approve access in your browser.
2. **Antigravity CLI**: Run `/mcp` in chat, select `hive-mcp`, and complete OAuth consent in your browser.
3. Run `/hive-setup` in chat anytime for guided setup, connectivity checks, or headless header-auth fallback options.

## Example prompts

- **Work execution & health**: `"Show me which projects are at risk and what needs attention this week"`
- **App Studio dashboards**: `"Build an App Studio dashboard to track progress, owners, and blockers"`
- **Forms & automations**: `"Design an intake form and automation workflow for incoming team requests"`
- **Approvals & proofing**: `"Summarize pending approvals across active creative projects and flag bottlenecks"`
- **Weekly planning & standups**: `"Use /weekly-plan to prioritize my assigned Hive work through Friday"` or `"Generate my /hive-standup"`
- **Meeting follow-up**: `"Use /meeting-follow-up to turn these notes into reviewed Hive actions"`
- **Resourcing & finance**: `"Review overdue invoices and draft follow-up actions for account owners"`
- **Developer PR workflows**: `"Open a PR for this branch and link it to my Hive action with /hive-pr"`

## Security & permissions

- **OAuth 2.0 by default**: Uses OAuth 2.0 (`mcp:read` and `mcp:write` scopes) with no bundled credentials or API keys.
- **Workspace permissions enforced**: Hive only exposes records and actions permitted by the signed-in user's existing workspace role.
- **Confirmation gates**: Destructive actions, bulk modifications, outbound email sends, approval stage changes, and Finance ledger writes (`destructiveHint: true`) require explicit user confirmation before execution.

## Support & policies

- **Website**: <https://hive.com>
- **Support / Help Center**: <https://help.hive.com/en/>
- **Privacy Policy**: <https://hive.com/policy-documents/privacy-policy>
- **Terms of Service**: <https://hive.com/policy-documents/terms-of-service>
- **License**: [MIT](LICENSE)
